title: A root flow mapping that starts after a tab is replaced by a flow mapping in place
notes: A tab may separate a flow collection from the start of its line (the yaml-test-suite case Q5MG), and it is not indentation, so the tab belongs to the document and stays. The root is an empty flow mapping; a flow collection written in place of another uses the flow form `{k: v}` and `, ` (Kit conventions: inserting into a flow collection), here with the inner sequence `[1]` in flow form too.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend refused the edit as one that would not read back; the pure backend wrote the expected bytes.
